question: In 2018, what was the investment in infrastructure as a percentage of GDP in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**30.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The amount of** Gross Domestic Product** that the** government spends on infrastructure construction** is known as "**Investment in Infrastructure as a Percentage of GDP."**
 
• In India, infrastructure spending as a share of GDP was** 30% in 2018.**
 
• India's GDP is expected to** rise by about 8% over the next three fiscal years,** according to **S&P Global Ratings.**
 
• The government wants to** increase manufacturing's contribution to GDP** from its present low of about **16%** to an all-time high of about **25% by 2025.**
 
• India has made considerable** investments in its infrastructure (approximately 35% of GDP),** but the government projects that over the next ten years, those investments **will total US$1.5 trillion. ​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• In **2022, Moody's **predicted that India's GDP growth will **decrease to 7%.**
 
• The** Reserve Bank of India** anticipates** 7% growth in 2022–2023.**
 
• The **Asian Development Bank (ADB)** predicted that the Indian economy will expand by **7%.**
 
• The** GDP growth rate** has been held steady at** 7.2% for 2023–2024.**
 
• The **overall infrastructure capex **is estimated to grow at a **CAGR of 11.4% over FY21-26 **driven by spending on **water supply, transport and urban infrastructure.**
 
• Investment in infrastructure contributed around **5% of the GDP in the 10th five year plan** as against **9% in the 11th** five year plan.
